name: @spacedatanetwork/body-imagery-tiles
description: A body's high-definition imagery from a global mosaic read by HTTP range: 256 px baseline JPEG tiles ($DTT records) on the two-root geographic scheme, packed 16 to a file in the layout the engine's imageryFromTileFiles reads (imagery/<NAIF id>/root.dtts, imagery/<NAIF id>/<L>/<X16>_<Y>.dtts); Mars THEMIS Day IR 100 m.
